title: Post-market clinical follow-up study on the use of resorbable magnesium screws (HBS 2 Resorb Mg) for indications of the hand and elbow
summary: The study investigates a specialized medical implant, a resorbable magnesium screw, which is already approved for use within the European Economic Area (EEA). The implant is intended for the reconstruction, stabilization, and alignment of bone structures during and after surgical procedures. The aim of the study is to evaluate the clinical performance and safety of the implant under routine clinical conditions.
conditions: Operative treatment of fractures of the hand and elbow. The study will specifically investigate the following fracture types: 1. Metacarpal fractures , 2. Proximal phalanx fractures , 3. Scaphoid fractures, 4. Radial styloid process fractures, 5. Radial head fractures

interventions.name: Patients who receive HBS 2 Resorb Mg screws for hand and ellbow

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Patient is undergoing surgery with HBS 2 Resorb Mg
-Written informed consent obtained for the treatment
-Indication met:
Metacarpal fractures 
Proximal phalanx fractures 
Scaphoid fractures
Radial styloid process fractures 
Radial head fractures
Exclusion criteria:
-Any not medically managed severe systemic disease
-Persons who are legally detained in an official institution
-Participation in any other medical device or medicinal product study within the previous month that could influence the results of the present study
-Skeletally immature
-Intraoperative decision to use implants other than the device under investigation
-Any contraindication of IFU applicable
